info.title: OnePlatform API
info.description: Complete OnePlatform API covering all platform services. For tenant-specific paths (ontology-defined entity routes), authenticate and call GET /api/v1/openapi.json.

tags.name: Apps
tags.description: App CRUD and metadata management.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Virtual File System for app source files. Each file has an optimistic lock version to prevent concurrent write conflicts.

tags.name: Builds
tags.description: Build pipeline management. Builds bundle the app VFS files via the Execution service and store artifacts in object storage.

tags.name: Deployments
tags.description: Deploy a build to production or roll back to a previous build.

tags.name: App Roles
tags.description: App-level RBAC roles and cross-tenant sharing grants.

tags.name: Env Vars
tags.description: Per-app environment variables. Secret values are AES-256 encrypted at rest.

tags.name: BFF
tags.description: Backend-for-Frontend endpoints consumed by the in-app SDK (@oneplatform/app-sdk). These endpoints enforce app-level auth and proxy requests to internal services.

tags.name: Bootstrap
tags.description: First-run platform initialization. One-time use — returns 410 Gone after completion.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Login, logout, token refresh, and password reset flows

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description: OAuth 2.0 provider authorization and callback flows

tags.name: API Keys
tags.description: Programmatic access credentials scoped to specific permissions

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: RBAC role management for tenant-scoped access control

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User management within a tenant

tags.name: Executions
tags.description: Code execution management. Submit snippets, poll status, and stream live logs. Requires execution:run to submit and execution:read to query.

tags.name: Meta
tags.description: OpenAPI spec endpoints. Serve the pre-built merged spec and, for authenticated requests, a tenant-specific overlay with concrete entity paths.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Outbound webhook subscriptions. The platform delivers events to registered URLs with HMAC-SHA256 signatures.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Server-Sent Event stream for real-time tenant-scoped event delivery.

tags.name: Data
tags.description: Dynamic entity data proxy. Routes requests to the Ingestion service for any entity type defined in the tenant's ontology.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Rate limit configuration. Requires the admin scope (platform-admin role only).

tags.name: Connectors
tags.description: Connector instances — configured plugin integrations that pull data from external sources on a schedule or on-demand.

tags.name: Syncs
tags.description: Sync history and real-time progress tracking for connector sync jobs.

tags.name: Webhook Receivers
tags.description: Inbound webhook receiver management. Receivers accept push events from external systems using HMAC-verified HTTP POST requests.

tags.name: File Uploads
tags.description: One-shot file ingestion for CSV, JSON, TSV, and NDJSON. Accepts up to 5GB. Files are streamed to object storage and parsed asynchronously.

tags.name: Logs
tags.description: Structured log query and export. Requires logs:read scope for query and logs:export scope for the streaming export endpoint.

tags.name: Audit Events
tags.description: Immutable audit trail of all platform actions. Non-admin callers are automatically scoped to their own tenant. Requires audit:read scope.

tags.name: Entities
tags.description: Entity type definitions. Each entity maps to a table in the tenant's dynamic schema. Breaking field changes (rename, type change) generate a migration.

tags.name: Migrations
tags.description: Schema migration lifecycle. Breaking changes produce a pending migration that must be confirmed before it is applied to the database.

tags.name: Mapping Rules
tags.description: Connector field → entity field mapping rules. Supports direct, expression, constant, and template transform types.

tags.name: Drafts
tags.description: Schema inference drafts auto-generated when a connector delivers its first batch of records. Drafts can be confirmed (creating entity types) or rejected.

tags.name: Pipelines
tags.description: Pipeline definitions. A pipeline is a versioned DAG of steps (code, connector, transformer, conditional, parallel, webhook) with optional concurrency options.

tags.name: Pipeline Runs
tags.description: Pipeline run management. Runs can be triggered manually, by schedule, or by internal service events. Logs are streamed in real time via SSE.

tags.name: Schedules
tags.description: Cron-based schedules that automatically trigger pipeline runs. Supports IANA timezone names and optional input templates.

tags.name: Plugins
tags.description: Plugin registry management. Installation and uninstallation require the platform-admin role.

tags.name: Plugin Instances
tags.description: Per-tenant plugin instances. Creating an instance enables the plugin for a specific tenant with custom configuration.

tags.name: Plugin Upgrades
tags.description: Versioned upgrade and rollback for installed plugins. Requires platform-admin role.

tags.name: Plugin Hooks
tags.description: Hook chain query for a plugin at a specific lifecycle stage.
